normal.text: Last week or so I finished my very first Final Fantasy game: The Pixel Remaster of Final Fantasy VI. I heard a lot of good things about it and this year I finally (sic!) started a genuine attempt to play it. What can I say? Such a great game. Lovely characters, epic plot, well narrated. And the music! The Pixel Remaster has a newly recorded orchestral soundtrack, which is epic... 🧵1/2 #retrogaming #finalfantasy #finalfantasy6 #finalfantasyvi #jrpg #rpg #videogames

normal.text: I've not ordered a Cardputer Zero yet, I do have a Carputer ADV that's only used as a Meshtastic node. But I am hugely tempted by a Cardputer Zero! The larger screen could make it the ultimate pocketable #ZXSpectrum or #C64 And with the built in HDMI port you can go straight from the hand held format to desktop instantly. Is anyone else considering one of these for emulating 8 bit computers? #retrocomputing #retrogaming #C64 #ZXSpectrum

normal.name: Dr. G. Power
normal.text: I played a little David's Midnight Magic and Midnight Magic tonight. On the C64 and the 2600. The C64 is way quicker with more natural physics, but somehow I prefer the Atari game. Perhaps I'm just used to it. Despite what the game art shows these games cannot be played with paddles. On the 2600 the buttons on the paddles work as the cover indicates, however, you cannot launch the ball. PS: The tables are totally different between these two games. #retrogaming #atari #commodore
